title: PADC Evidence Lab
description:
Audit-oriented research prototype for an agentic evidence contract. The implementation separates proposal, evidence, admissibility, and adjudication, with explicit source-completeness and provenance-binding safeguards.

Version 0.1.1.1 is the Missingness Identity / Immutability Patch on the Source-Completeness and Provenance-Binding Hardened Prototype. It is a hardened reference prototype and freeze candidate, not a validated PADC implementation, semantic evidence engine, production security certification, or tamper-resistant ledger.
